column1: # UK Systems Map - Empty Template
# Fill in the rows under each section. Save as .csv. Drag onto the app to load.
# Sections start with a line like `# SECTION: <name>`.
# The first non-comment row of each section is the column header. Do NOT change column names.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored.
# Empty rows are ignored.
# Build order recommendation:
#   1. Decide your streams (rows) - functional flows or domains.
#   2. Decide your stages (columns) - the lifecycle from inputs to outcomes
#   3. Decide your categories - node types (resource
#   4. Add nodes - one per cell of the stream x stage grid you want to populate.
#   5. Add edges - causal links between nodes (from -> to).
#   6. (Optional) Set baselines + elasticities to enable the Simulation feature.
# SECTION: streams
# id        - unique stream identifier (referenced from nodes). Lowercase
# label     - display name shown in the sidebar and detail panel.
# short     - short label shown on the map row header (uppercase
# color     - hex colour for the stream (e.g. #60a5fa). Used for the left bar on each node.
id
# SECTION: stages
# id    - stage identifier (referenced from nodes). Lowercase
# label - column header shown on the map. Stages appear left-to-right in the order listed here.
id
# SECTION: categories
# id          - category identifier (referenced from nodes). Lowercase
# label       - display name shown in the sidebar legend.
# color       - fill colour for nodes of this category (hex).
# text_color  - label text colour (hex). Pick a high-contrast value relative to the fill.
id
# SECTION: defaults
# Default elasticities used when an edge's `elasticity` cell is left blank.
# Elasticity = percent change in target value per percent change in source value.
# For `decreases` effects
# These three rows are pre-filled with sensible starting values. Tune later if needed.
key
elasticity_enables
elasticity_increases
elasticity_decreases
# SECTION: nodes
# id           - unique node identifier (referenced from edges). Lowercase
# label        - display name shown on the node.
# description  - tooltip text and detail panel description. Wrap in quotes if it contains commas.
# stream       - which stream this node belongs to (must match an id from the `streams` section).
# stage        - which stage column this node sits in (must match an id from the `stages` section).
# category     - node category (must match an id from the `categories` section).
# The fields below are OPTIONAL. Fill them in to enable the Simulation feature for this node:
# baseline     - baseline numeric value (e.g. 9000 for FTE
# unit         - unit string shown after the value (e.g. FTE
# controllable - 'true' to expose this node as a slider in Simulation mode. Use for exogenous inputs only.
# direction    - 'higher_better'
column3: or 'neutral'. Set on outcome metrics to drive status colouring.

id
# SECTION: edges
# from        - source node id.
# to          - target node id.
# effect      - 'enables'
column3: or 'decreases'. Determines arrow colour and default elasticity sign.

column1: #                 enables   = structural prerequisite (X must exist for Y to happen)
#                 increases = X going up tends to push Y up
#                 decreases = X going up tends to push Y down
# elasticity  - OPTIONAL. Per-edge elasticity override (signed number). Leave blank to use the default for the effect type.
# description - explanation shown in the detail panel.
from
